package_type_evolution: Originally shipped as an Industry Classification Package (v1.0.0-RC1, 2026-07-22): 5 datasets characterizing livelihood/industry categories with an 18-field core schema. Evolved in this release into a Business Opportunity Knowledge Base: 4 of the 5 datasets (all except the scheme/support-body reference dataset) were deep-enriched to a 36-column schema answering practical entrepreneurship questions per opportunity (investment, machinery, suppliers, training, licenses, marketing channels, AI tools, district suitability, etc.), sourced wherever reliable public information exists.
scope: MSME & Entrepreneurship Support Schemes (support-layer reference), Food & Agro-Processing Micro-Enterprises, Construction & Skilled Trade Services, Digital & Technology Livelihoods, and China-Inspired Adapted Opportunities (all 4 as full Business Opportunity records) for Telangana & Andhra Pradesh (architected to extend to all ~150 briefed industry/livelihood sub-categories and all Indian states without schema change)

datasets_included.name: china_inspired_adapted_opportunities
datasets_included.schema_tier: Business Opportunity (deep-enriched, includes disclosed Tier-5 qualitative color)

datasets_blocked.name: Textile & Garments
datasets_blocked.reason: Extremely large and fragmented category spanning traditional and industrial scales; no tractable narrow slice identified this session
datasets_blocked.unblock_requires: Dedicated research pass with a defined narrower slice agreed with the requester first

datasets_blocked.name: Retail & Local Commerce (general)
datasets_blocked.reason: Grocery, kirana modernization, hyperlocal delivery, tea cafes, organic stores, pet stores individually fragmented with no authoritative registry (the social-commerce angle is already covered in china_inspired_adapted_opportunities.csv)

datasets_blocked.name: Repair & Maintenance Services
datasets_blocked.reason: Mobile/laptop/TV/appliance repair, CCTV/solar installation, EV/bicycle repair individually fragmented with no authoritative registry
datasets_blocked.unblock_requires: Dedicated research pass; likely lower achievable confidence

environment_constraint: Direct WebFetch to .gov.in/.ac.in/.nic.in domains was blocked by this session's organizational egress policy across both the RC1 collection pass and the v2 deep-enrichment pass (confirmed HTTP 403 policy denial, re-tested live before each pass began). All data collected via WebSearch result snippets only; numeric investment figures required a specific citable government project-profile source or were left PENDING_VERIFICATION. Confidence scores capped at 85. See docs/METHODOLOGY.md.
dependencies: No hard foreign-key dependency on Package001_Geography, Package002_Education, or Package003_Healthcare. Datasets in this package characterize livelihood/industry opportunities, not individually-verified institutions, so the relational model differs from prior packages — see schemas/schema_catalog.json.

source_tiers_used: Tier 4 (Trusted news, for scheme renames, policy transitions, and named success stories)
Tier 5 (Community sources — founder interviews, forums, YouTube creators — used ONLY in china_inspired_adapted_opportunities for qualitative color, explicitly flagged in notes)
source_tiers_not_used: Tier 3 (Verified social media — not needed this release)

confidence_statistics.note: Confidence rose from RC1's 70.5 average to 74.4 in the v2 enrichment pass, reflecting genuinely stronger and more numerous corroborating sources found for previously-thin fields (each row raised by at most +8, none lowered). Still below Package001-003's typical ceilings because this package's core content (investment ranges, machinery costs, success stories for livelihood categories) is inherently harder to source to a specific government document than institutional facts. See docs/METHODOLOGY.md.

known_gaps: 16.93% of all fields package-wide (320 of 1,890) remain PENDING_VERIFICATION — concentrated in minimum_investment, working_capital_summary, estimated_setup_time_summary, seasonal_factors_summary, ai_tools_summary, and success_stories_summary, where no reliable public source was found. See reports/business_opportunity_enrichment_summary.md for the exact per-field fill-rate table.

Estimated Monthly Revenue Range remains dropped from the schema entirely — no reliable public source exists for typical small-business revenue in these categories; attempting it would mean 100% PENDING_VERIFICATION or fabrication risk.

msme_entrepreneurship_support_schemes was deliberately NOT migrated to the 36-column Business Opportunity schema — it characterizes support infrastructure (schemes/bodies), not individual opportunities a person starts, so the richer schema does not apply to it.
Facebook Marketplace, named in the package brief's own examples, was checked and confirmed NOT officially launched in India.
Telangana's MSME Policy 2024 vs. the older T-IDEA/T-PRIDE framework overlap is unresolved — conflicting subsidy figures found, left PENDING_VERIFICATION rather than guessed.
~145 of ~150 briefed sub-categories not researched in this release (BLOCKED/QUEUED, not guessed).
Coverage limited to Telangana, Andhra Pradesh, and national-level entities — remaining states/UTs QUEUED.
No row has been promoted to VST-VERIFIED; that is a separate governance action.

A small number of china_inspired_adapted_opportunities rows/fields rely on Tier-5 qualitative sourcing (forums, YouTube creators) rather than authoritative documents — explicitly flagged in notes, not presented as equivalent-confidence to government-sourced fields.
